claims.claim_text: The indexed William C. Dabney is a high-confidence match to the Louisville aviator whom the Aviation Museum of Kentucky identifies with early OSS service.

claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact first name, middle initial and surname, explicit OSS identification, Louisville and wartime aviation chronology, and an official 1944 commissioned assignment.
claims.temporal_assessment: The museum places education before World War II service and identifies OSS activity during the war. It does not give an OSS entry date.
claims.match_notes: The index has no rank or private identifier. Two exact-name Army rows remain unlinked; one Kentucky row is compatible but differs by one birth year and is not assigned without a direct bridge.

research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 163 for the precise identity, education dates, Army and OSS pathway and any civilian employer.
